trailhead.label: Valdaora di Sopra, on the Pustertal cycle path, the board’s start

cautions: Shared with cyclists on the Pustertal cycle path: keep your dog close and on the right.
Fenced stretch above the reservoir: do not let your dog down to the water.
Short stretches on village roads at each end.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
